questions.q_en: Who among the following is credited with the invention of the first automatic calculator?
questions.solution_en:
• Wilhelm Schickard invented the first automatic calculator in 1623, known as the "Calculating Clock."

• Blaise Pascal developed a mechanical calculator known as the Pascaline in 1642.

• Charles Babbage is regarded as the "Father of the Computer" for designing the Analytical Engine.

• John Napier is famous for inventing logarithms.

questions.q_en: Who discovered the blood groups?
questions.solution_en:
Karl Landsteiner, an Austrian biologist and physician, is credited with discovering the ABO blood groups in 1901.

Karl Landsteiner discovered why: when different people's blood was mixed, the red blood cells sometimes clumped. He explained in 1901 that people have different types of red blood cells, that is, there are different blood groups. The discovery led to safe blood transfusions between people with compatible blood groups. He won Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine (1930).

• Rene Laennec invented the stethoscope (1816).

• Christian Schonbein discovered ozone (1839).

questions.q_en:
Consider the following statements regarding the development of the atomic bomb and choose the correct statement.

(a) The Manhattan Project was the secret US initiative to develop the atomic bomb during World War II.

(b) The first atomic bomb was tested in Hiroshima before being used in warfare.

(c) Julius Robert Oppenheimer is regarded as the "Father of the Atomic Bomb."

• The Manhattan Project was the secret US-led project that developed the atomic bomb.

• The first atomic bomb was tested in New Mexico (Trinity Test, July 16, 1945), not in Hiroshima.

• Julius Robert Oppenheimer is known as the Father of the Atomic Bomb.
